codeObservations.observed: loadEvents sets isLoading, awaits listTodayWorkEvents, then commits events and clears loading for the latest request.

codeObservations.claim: Loading and post-load empty labels use separate conditional behavior
codeObservations.observed: The first two sections pass hideEmptyText, which suppresses their post-load empty labels; while loading, SchedulerEventSection explicitly renders 불러오는 중... regardless of hideEmptyText. The Today 전체 section also renders the loading message and then an empty message.
The request starts loading without clearing events; non-empty sections therefore keep rendering old cards while refetch is pending.
Loaded cards are conditionally rendered with no admitted entry/reveal state in the inspected JSX.
